mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term monetary policy pivot and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy pivot expectation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint HOUST and RSAFS contraction periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers a flight-to-safety dynamic that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 104.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 460,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1,220,000 units, signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to outperform individual proxies in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 240.0 indicates a tightening monetary cycle amid persistent inflation, which increases the risk of a rate hike-induced earnings contraction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 240.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250,000 jobs in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.8%), signals labor market overheating, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both PAYEMS > 250k and UNRATE < 4.8% (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized in the most recent quarter, combined with a drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0, signals a weakening economy and increases the probability of a policy response, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 < 1.0 and INDPRO < 104.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).
